purpose: Technical architecture for a future WERK deliberative/member/citizen ballot path that separates eligibility from ballot secrecy and remains distinct from official Austrian elections or referenda.
hard_boundaries: No official election/referendum function is claimed.
No ballot is active and no real vote can be cast.
Verified-support pseudonyms are never reused as ballot identifiers.
Identity/eligibility service must not receive the ballot choice.
Ballot store must not contain raw identity.
No quorum, threshold, franchise, binding effect or revoting rule is selected by this technical architecture.
No home-grown cryptography may be activated without independent specialist review and audited implementation.

layers.purpose: Verify eligibility and issue a single-use anonymous voting credential without ballot choice.
Accept a valid anonymous credential, enforce single-use/replay protection and store only an encrypted/secret ballot representation.
Produce a tally with separation of duties and verifiability appropriate to the selected reviewed scheme.
Audit configuration, credential consumption and tally integrity without logging voter choice or identity-choice linkage.

architecture_candidates.description: Eligibility service issues a blinded/single-use credential; ballot is encrypted for a threshold-controlled tally. Exact protocol/library is not selected.
Voter proves eligibility/single-use property with an anonymous credential or zero-knowledge proof and submits an encrypted ballot. Exact credential/proof/tally stack is not selected.

threat_model.required_control: separate services/stores/keys and no shared stable pseudonym
atomic spent-credential set without ballot-choice logging
credential validity + append-only ballot ledger + independent tally reconciliation
separation of duties and threshold/multi-party key control where scheme requires
server-side validation plus independent verifiability; client UI cannot define eligibility/result
must be explicitly addressed by selected protocol; architecture makes no receipt-freeness claim yet
availability plan, rate controls and documented contingency without silently extending/changing ballot rules
reproducible tally verification and immutable result artifact

acceptance_path: independent legal review of intended WERK use
synthetic election threat tests and recovery drill
